# Rivera Welding Auto Mechanic

> Muffler, welding & auto repair based in Austin, Texas. Pull in without an appointment. Mufflers, catalytic converters, welding and everyday repairs at 3528 E 7th St, done quick and priced fair.

## Services
- Exhaust & mufflers: New mufflers, pipes and tips, or a full exhaust system. Parts are often in stock, so many jobs are done the same day.
- Catalytic converters: Converter stolen or failed? One customer's stolen converter was replaced in under an hour, with no appointment.
- Welding & repairs: Welding is in our name. If something on your car has broken or come loose, bring it by and we'll take a look.
- Brakes & suspension: Squeaks, grinding or a rough ride. We put it on the lift and find what's wrong.
- A/C repair: When the A/C quits in an Austin summer, bring it in and we'll get it checked.
- Tune-ups & oil changes: The everyday work that keeps your car running, from a tune-up to a synthetic oil change on a work truck.

## About
Rivera Welding Auto Mechanic is the red, yellow and blue shop at 3528 E 7th St in East Austin, next to the 7-Eleven. Look for the white sign with RIVERA WELDING in big letters and the row of new exhaust pipes out front. Exhaust is the specialty: mufflers, pipes, tips and catalytic converters. We're a walk-in shop, so you can pull in without an appointment, and with parts often in stock, plenty of jobs are done while you wait or by the afternoon. We also weld, fix what's broken and take care of the everyday work: brakes, suspension, A/C, tune-ups and oil changes. Customers mention Juan by name, and say our prices are fair and that we work with their budget.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. We're a walk-in shop. Pull into 3528 E 7th St during business hours, or call (512) 389-2029 first if you want to check.
- Q: My catalytic converter was stolen. How fast can you replace it?
  A: Often the same day. One customer had a stolen converter replaced in under an hour with no appointment, and another dropped off in the morning and picked up in the early afternoon. Call ahead and we'll tell you if we have the part for your car.
- Q: Do you weld things besides exhaust?
  A: Yes. Welding is in our name. We weld exhaust and suspension components on cars and trucks, and we've repaired things like a trunk latch that tore loose from the body. Bring it by or call and describe it.
- Q: What else do you work on?
  A: Brakes, suspension, A/C, tune-ups and oil changes, on cars, trucks and SUVs.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 3528 E 7th St, Austin, TX 78702, next to the 7-Eleven. Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6:30 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 6 PM, closed Sunday.
